::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 96,221 people lived in County Westmeath, up 8.4% on 2016. It had the 17th largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 68% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Westmeath was €1,257, the 10th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
